annotations.title: Fiscal year, quarter and period for a date

description: Fiscal year, quarter and period for a date — Which fiscal year, quarter, period and week does a date fall in? Give any fiscal-year start month or a preset (us-federal, us-states, uk, japan, india, canada, australia) and get the fiscal year and its label (FY2027 or FY2026-27), quarter and half with start and end dates, fiscal month (P01-P12), fiscal week, day of the fiscal year and days left in the quarter and year. Offline, instant. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).

fy_label.description: end (default, FY named for the year it ends) | start

fy_start.description: month 1-12, month name, or preset such as us-federal
